text: The lunch in the fridge. White bag. My name on it. In Sharpie. Two times.
You got barbecue sauce on your eyebrow.
You don't bring lunch, Dre. You have never brought lunch. Not one time in three years.
Meal prep? That's my mama's chicken. She cut the crust off my sandwich, because I asked her to. Your sandwich got no crust, Dre.
Your napkin says, Skip, have a good day. Love, Mama.
There's no fridge rules! Who told you that?
The paper says, clean out your old food on Friday. It's Tuesday!
You ate my chicken, my sandwich, and my pudding cup.
Mid? You ate it, and you gave it a review?
No. Not Friday. Last Friday you paid me forty dollars.
Dre. Where did that forty dollars come from?
So you paid me back. With my own money.
